Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present — several large caps show 1W/1M conflicts (MSFT CORRECTION, TSLA CORRECTION, V CORRECTION) → MAJOR divergence, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with dispersion: AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND; many names are RECOVERY or BELOW TREND despite strong short-term movers. Sector reads: overall weak on 1W, selective opportunities only.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials soft on the week: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND with payments names mixed — V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — sector in internal rotation, no clear bid.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare weakest on the board with broad downside: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — defensive underperformance and headline-driven selling in names like NVS and SYK.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to Energy and confirmed Tech winners (XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND), and reduce exposure to weak Healthcare and pressured consumer names (SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence argues for tactical positioning and nearer-term risk management.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND — momentum; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND — rebound to monitor; XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND — commodity catalyst.  
BEARISH: SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND — earnings/guide risk, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND — deal scrutiny, ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — sentiment-driven weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy — only sector positive this week, monitor XOM/CVX/VLO for follow-through.  
BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary — broad selling and headline risk; Technology should be watched for leadership concentration and reversals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch AAPL 190 area for near-term support (AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND). NVDA resistance zone near prior highs (~450) while NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND needs reclaim to stabilize. AMD breakout level near recent swing highs (~120) for continuation (AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND). XOM support around mid-100s to confirm Energy leadership (XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence across large caps (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA BELOW TREND, multiple names in RECOVERY) and headline-driven Healthcare weakness — monitor for confirmation before reallocating.
